claim: The Mail tab status line says Connected only on evidence: a letter stored through the house mailbox while it is read, a letter stored at the house's Mudavym address, or the house's test letter arriving. An address row alone reads 'Address made, no letter yet', and MailTab feeds the test-letter arrival from GET /communications/mail-setup into the line (QA round 26, #977; fix/mail-status-on-evidence).
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; W='apps/web/src/pages/communications/next/'; R=lambda p: re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*][\s\S]*?[*]/','',open(p).read())); bad=[]; mf=R(W+'mail-format.ts'); f=mf[mf.find('export function mailStatusLine('):mf.find('export interface SenderLineInput')]; bad+=['the address row alone still makes the line Connected'] if 'hasAddress' in f else []; bad+=['Connected is not gated on evidence'] if not re.search(r'const proof = newest[(]mailboxOpen [?] lastInMailbox : null, lastAtAddress, testArrived[)]', f) else []; bad+=['an unproven address is not said plainly'] if 'Address made, no letter yet' not in f else []; mt=R(W+'MailTab.tsx'); bad+=['MailTab does not feed the test letter into the line'] if not re.search(r'mailStatusLine[(]reader, summary, [{][^}]*test [}][)]', mt) else []; print(chr(10).join(bad) or 'ok'); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
